verdict.rationale: Asana's App Directory lists multiple third-party integrations enabling two-way sync with code-repo issue trackers (GitLab 2-way sync, GitHub PR status sync, Bitbucket sync, Jira Cloud Data Sync, and a generic 'Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab' one/two-way sync connector), plus webhooks/API for building custom sync. These are largely third-party apps rather than a native first-party Asana-built bi-directional sync, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of these syncs in practice. Missing for 10: first-party native sync (not third-party app dependency), independent verification of sync reliability/completeness, and explicit handling of conflict resolution.
